summary: Fresh ink-first reread of every supplied page for five early Glasgow testament cases, including debts, witnesses and continuations outside the featured walkthrough boxes. The pass confirms the principal spouse/child/sibling clauses, adds several probable account associates, and retains physical or palaeographic uncertainty where the record cannot support kinship. New readings are labelled separately from confirmations of maintained conclusions.

findings.previous: Geillis Glasgow, Thomas Wilson, Chaplehill and Ardrossan already read
findings.reading: Geillis glasgw, spouse to Thomas Wilson in Chaplehill within Ardrossan parish; died intestate January 1603
findings.basis: Clear name, spous wording, locality and date in opening
findings.relationship_effect: Confirms marriage only; no parentage

findings.previous: James, Isobel and Bessie Wilson named; relationships unresolved

findings.basis: Names and office are visible; words after James remain ambiguous even in tight enlargement
findings.relationship_effect: No son/daughter relationship should be created from executorship
